name: Craftsman's Writ: Crimson Silk Robe
summary: A transferable writ requests one Crimson Silk Robe and names a delivery place and payment. You need the writ to complete the transaction.

sections.title: The Writ
sections.body: A customer’s faded note asks for a Crimson Silk Robe. It also gives a delivery place and payment, and the writ can pass from hand to hand. Carry it when you bring the requested robe to the marked place, for the transaction requires the writ itself.

faq.answer: The customer asks for one Crimson Silk Robe.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the robe?
faq.answer: The writ gives a delivery place, marked on your map.
The writ includes information about payment.
Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: Do I need the writ to complete the transaction?
faq.answer: Yes. You need to have the writ with you to complete the transaction.
